name: Morse.accel
why: Project: covD c (deriv c) t = prj (c t) (deriv (deriv c) t); blind: P_{c(t)}(deriv (deriv c) t) with P the projection onto the span of velocities. As for covD: the projections agree at c t in N (tangentSpace_eq) and both are 0 at c t not in N. Equal for all arguments, including the break-point and end-point junk values (two-sided deriv on both sides).
